snippet.title: Into the Darkness | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your deck. Choose your path. Decide what makes it home.

Into the Darkness is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder with branching expeditions, class abilities and a collection that grows between runs. Prepare at the Lantern Yard, face bosses and shape your next build with what you bring back.

Available now in Early Access on Google Play. Windows testing signups are open for a limited time.

Play on Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nightfalldigital.intothedarkness

Game and latest updates:
https://nightfall.digital/into-the-darkness-game/

Request Windows testing:
https://nightfall.digital/into-the-darkness-beta/#beta-request

Join the community:
https://discord.gg/4CCGwseR7z

Follow development live:
https://www.twitch.tv/shidodev

Music from the Into the Darkness soundtrack.
Development footage. Features and visuals may change.
